title: Lenz’s law: magnet and coil
back: N pole approaching makes the near face N (repels); you must do work, which becomes electrical energy.

title: Rod sliding on rails
back: emf = Blv; I = Blv/R; the retarding force B²l²v/R must be balanced to keep v constant.

title: Magnetic flux
legend: θ = angle between B and the normal
back: Change B, A or θ to induce an emf.

title: Faraday’s law
legend: - = Lenz's law: the induced emf opposes the change
back: A steady flux, however large, induces nothing.

title: Motional emf
back: Same result from the Lorentz force on the rod’s free charges.

title: Self-induced emf
back: Inductance opposes changes in current, like inertia.

title: Self-inductance of a solenoid
back: Doubling N makes L four times; an iron core multiplies it by μᵣ.

title: Mutual inductance of coaxial solenoids
legend: r₁ = radius of the inner solenoid
back: M₁₂ = M₂₁. Use the inner cross-section.

title: Lenz’s law in one line
back: "Lenz = ladne wala": the induced current always fights the change in flux. N comes in → near face N; N goes away → near face S.
